verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers and serves requests at low latency near infrastructure and users. That covers the relay-layer half of the story. The docs only describe connecting server-side SDKs to it, it must be hosted yourself, and nothing shows flags evaluated inside CDN workers. Missing for 10: CDN/edge-worker evaluation support, a vendor-managed edge network, documented client-side SDK use through the proxy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Edge Proxy.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: The Flagsmith Edge Proxy is a service that you host yourself, that allows you to run an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers.
Run the Edge Proxy within in your own infrastructure and connect to it from your server-side SDKs
This means you can serve a very large number of requests close to your infrastructure and users, at very low latency.
